assets.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: production game menu backdrop, 1536x1024 landscape. Create a spectacular premium WWE-inspired wrestling videogame title screen for the original brand RINGSIDE. Photoreal cinematic arena with a square wrestling ring in the RIGHT TWO THIRDS, three scarlet ropes, black corner pads, dramatic overhead white stadium spotlights, blood-red LED stage, crowd silhouettes, smoke and scattered sparks. No wrestlers. LEFT THIRD very dark smoky charcoal with faint red haze, empty enough for live interface overlays. Across upper left / center-left set enormous beautifully rendered beveled brushed-chrome condensed italic typography on TWO LINES reading exactly "RING" then "SIDE", with a sweeping red slash beneath. Title occupies x=6%-44%, y=24%-54%. Small text above title reads exactly "THE MAIN EVENT". Bottom left stays dark and empty for an interactive red button added later. Bottom right ring apron has very small "RINGSIDE" text. Aggressive authentic televised wrestling PPV art direction, gritty black steel, crimson and silver, strong diagonal composition, film grain, razor sharp typography. No interface cards, no buttons, no health meters, no watermarks. This image will be used DIRECTLY as the menu artwork in a game, not as a mockup on a device.
